test_access_public_endpoint: test the server returns 200 for public endpoints /health and /models without authentication
test_access_static_assets_without_api_ke: test static web UI assets like /, /bundle.js, /bundle.css are accessible without API key
test_incorrect_api_key: test the server rejects requests with missing or invalid API keys with 401 authentication_error
test_correct_api_key: test the server accepts requests with valid Bearer token or X-Api-Key header and returns content
test_cors_options: test the server handles CORS OPTIONS preflight requests with correct Access-Control-Allow headers
